headline: Qualcomm unveils two Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips
summary: Qualcomm announced two versions of its flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip, including an Extreme variant, with spec differences mostly limited to improved AI processing, video capture, and gaming performance.

claims.statement: Qualcomm announced two versions of its flagship chip: the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and an Extreme variant.

sources.quote: Qualcomm is making not one but two versions of its flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip
Qualcomm has announced the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, this year joined by the 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 too.

claims.statement: The Verge reports the spec differences between the two chips are relatively minor, mostly improved AI processing, video capture, and gaming performance on the Extreme model.

sources.quote: the spec differences are relatively minor, mostly limited to improved AI processing, video capture, and gaming performance on the Extreme model

claims.statement: Engadget highlights the chip's video capture capability.

sources.quote: That video capture is nothing to sneeze at.
